tasks.short: Customize an insurance program for one customer's risks.

steps.what: Read the customer's risks and existing insurance covers.
Draft a program that covers the open risks.

loop.input: Risk list and the product wording
loop.output: Program draft with cover, limit and exclusion lines
loop.check: Agent checks each line against the wording
loop.stop: One draft; a line with no wording is dropped
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text risks do not map onto a fixed cover code

steps.what: Judge which program fits this customer's risks.
Explain that insurance program in the customer meeting.
Write the agreed program on the customer record.

tasks.design: The {CRM} lists current covers beside the risks the agent typed. A draft program is checked against product wording, then the agent decides and explains it in the meeting. The agreed lines are written back only after that conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programs were rebuilt from notes and product booklets for each visit, and the fit was not in a field.
tasks.enabler_now: Product wording and the customer file now share cover, limit and exclusion fields, so the draft can be checked line by line.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing which risk the customer will actually leave uninsured.
tasks.human_edge: The agent hears which exclusion the customer will accept.

ambition.what: The agent decides in the meeting which risks stay outside the program, instead of rebuilding the pack afterwards.

tasks.altitude: Meetings stay on the week. The agent can refuse to present a program that failed the wording check.

reach.task: Match a buyer's constraints to a property before the viewing
reach.learn: Which constraints they keep as fields, and which they only say in the room

evidence.claim: A Dutch insurance system uses one certified product-definition format for policy records and renewals.
Advising staff need a Wft diploma per product and professional education every three years.
Choosing cover for a person, and saying it in the meeting, stays with the adviser.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from the customer file to the program recorded after the meeting. Binding cover and claims handling are out of scope.
Structured fields are risk name, existing cover, limit, exclusion and product code. The agent produces the risk names. Fallback: blank lines stay empty for the agent to type.
Test the {CRM} product templates before custom code. {CRM} runtime is not the agent's time.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours is template changes when a product wording changes.
Advice stays with a person who holds the Wft diploma for that product. Life and health price setting is not part of this task.
unknowns: Whether product wording is already a field in the {CRM}, or only a document.
How often one customer needs more than one insurer in the same program.
research_questions: What share of risks already have a product code before the meeting?
How often does the customer change the program during the meeting?

already_counted.description: Wording check on the draft program
Fit judgement before the meeting explanation

incremental.description: Revise program templates when product wording changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: most risks are unusual and the meeting rebuilds the program. High case: the file already holds cover codes and only the explanation stays manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sell insurance policies to a business or an individual.

steps.what: List insurance policies that match the stated need.
Sell those policies in the meeting with the client.
Request signature on the application from the sale.

loop.input: Sale notes and the application form
loop.output: Application with named policies and sums
loop.check: Agent checks every sum and name before the request goes out
loop.stop: One draft; a blank sum blocks the request
loop.why_not_simpler: The meeting notes are not a completed form

steps.what: Sign the application the agent sent.

tasks.design: The {CRM} shortlists policies from the need the agent recorded. The sale itself stays a meeting. The {ESIGN} request uses the notes only after the agent checks names and sums.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applications were retyped from meeting notes, and the sale itself cannot be handed to a script.
tasks.enabler_now: The application fields now match the product file, so the request can be filled without a second typing.
tasks.still_hard: The client decides in the room, and a wrong sum is hard to undo.
tasks.human_edge: The agent hears the objection and chooses which policy to stop on.
tasks.altitude: The selling meetings stay. The agent stops retyping the application after a yes.

reach.task: Confirm a trip with the traveller before any ticket is issued
reach.learn: Which booking fields they refuse to send until the person has agreed

evidence.claim: A CRM can send a quote for online signature, and its assistant acts only after a person approves.
An undisclosed bot is a poor stand-in for the adviser, and telling the customer it is a bot changes whether they buy.
Advising staff need a Wft diploma per product and professional education every three years.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from a stated need to a signed application. Issuing the policy is the insurer's work.
Structured fields are product code, insured name, sum and start date. The agent produces them from the meeting. Fallback: the agent types any blank before the signature request.
Test the {CRM} application template and {ESIGN} step before custom code.
Upkeep of 1.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers form changes. The client's signing time is not the agent's hour.
No undisclosed bot speaks to the client. A model may fill the form; the agent sends it.
unknowns: Whether this agency already sends applications through {ESIGN}.
What share of sales close in the first meeting.
research_questions: Which policy types still need a paper application?
How often does the client change a sum after the meeting?

already_counted.description: Check of the application before signature

incremental.description: Update application templates when a product form changes

approvals.approved_version: application version checked by the agent

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the meeting is the whole task and the form is still handwritten. High case: only the shortlist and the form filling shrink, and the sale stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain policy features, advantages and disadvantages.

steps.what: Collect features of the policies to explain.
Draft advantages and disadvantages for each feature.

loop.input: Feature list taken from product wording
loop.check: Agent deletes any line that is not in the wording
loop.stop: One pass; a feature with no wording is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Advantages are sentences, not fields on the product record

steps.what: Explain features, advantages and disadvantages in the meeting.
File the comparison the customer was shown.

tasks.design: A comparison sheet is filled from {DOCS} wording and checked by the agent. The explanation stays a meeting. The sheet is stored on the {CRM} record afterwards, not sent as advice on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feature sheets were copied from booklets by hand before each explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Product wording is in fields, so advantages can be drafted only from those lines.
tasks.still_hard: The customer asks a question the sheet did not expect, and the answer is still advice.
tasks.human_edge: The agent chooses which disadvantage to say first.

ambition.what: A buyer who asks one question by mail can receive the same checked comparison, without waiting for a full visit.

tasks.altitude: Explanation meetings stay. The agent can hand a sheet that only contains wording they checked.

reach.role: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
reach.task: Explain a product's costs and limits before a client decides
reach.learn: Which sentences they refuse to leave in a written comparison

evidence.claim: A written comparison of policy features is still advice when the customer relies on it.
Advising staff need a Wft diploma per product and professional education every three years.
Product features for a standard policy can be listed from a shared definition format.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from product wording to the comparison filed after the explanation. The sale is a separate task.
Structured fields are product code, feature, advantage and disadvantage. The insurer wording produces the feature. Fallback: the agent writes any feature the draft leaves blank.
Test the {DOCS} product page and {CRM} activity template before custom code.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers wording changes. The sheet is not a quote and not a price.
The agent remains the adviser under the Wft rule. The sheet is not sent until the agent has used it in the explanation, except for the mail case in the ambition.
unknowns: Whether disadvantage text is already stored per product, or only implied by exclusions.
Whether a mail explanation is treated as advice in this agency.
research_questions: What share of explanations use a standard product rather than a tailored program?
How often does the customer ask for the sheet after the meeting?

incremental.description: Refresh advantage lines when product wording changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the customer's questions make the sheet useless and the meeting is the whole task. High case: standard products reuse a checked sheet and only the talk stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep policy records and handle renewals.

steps.what: Pull policies that are due for renewal.
Retype renewal terms the record already holds.
Review renewals that fail the standard rules.
Update the policy record for an accepted renewal.
Draft the renewal notice from the renewed record.

loop.output: Renewal notice with date, premium and cover
loop.check: Agent checks date, premium and cover against the record
loop.stop: One draft; a missing premium stops the notice
loop.why_not_simpler: The notice wording is a letter, not only fields

steps.what: Send the renewal notice the agent approved.

tasks.design: The {CRM} renewal queue copies unchanged terms and writes the new record. The agent reviews only renewals that fail the rules, edits the notice, and the {EMAIL} send waits for that check. Native renewal settings are used before any extra code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Due lists and notices were copied off the policy screen into mail, one policy at a time.
tasks.enabler_now: A shared product format and a renewal date field make the unchanged cases a rule.
tasks.still_hard: A change in the customer's risks is not a field the queue can see.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows which customer will not accept a flat renewal.

ambition.what: The agent decides the same morning which renewals are not standard, instead of finding them while retyping.

tasks.altitude: The week drops most of the retyping. The agent still stops a renewal that the rule should not send.

reach.task: Review a standard instruction before it is sent to a client
reach.learn: Which instruction fields they refuse to send without a person

evidence.claim: A Dutch insurance system uses one certified product-definition format for policy records and renewals.
A CRM can send a quote for online signature, and its assistant acts only after a person approves.
Renewal notices to customers are external sends and stay behind a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from a policy due for renewal to the notice sent. Pricing a new program is out of scope.
Structured fields are policy number, renewal date, premium, cover code and exception reason. The policy record produces them. Fallback: the agent completes any blank and holds the notice.
Test the {CRM} renewal queue and notice template before custom code. Engine time is not agent time.
Upkeep of 6 hours per 100 baseline hours covers rule and template changes. Exception review is already in the remaining step.
A premium change on life or health cover is not produced by a new model here. Those notices stay in the exception review.
unknowns: Whether the {CRM} already has a renewal queue for this book.
What share of renewals change price or cover.
research_questions: What share of the book renews with no change in cover?
Who may stop a renewal notice after the agent has approved it?

incremental.description: Maintain renewal rules and notice templates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the queue already exists and many renewals change cover, so only the notice draft shrinks. High case: most terms are unchanged and the hand list disappears. Life and health price changes stay manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Customer meetings stay. Retyping of programs and flat renewals leaves the week. The agent can hold a notice or a program that failed a check.

skills_to_grow: Checking a draft against product wording
